verdict.rationale: Algolia's own Agent Studio connects an LLM to your Algolia indices and grounds responses in live index data. It supports content summarizers, conversational search and shopping assistants, so AI-generated answers and suggestions from your data are a first-party feature. However, these are agents you configure and deploy for your search experience, and the dashboard's search analytics are metrics rather than AI-generated insights. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or recommendations surfaced to the account owner in the dashboard (e.g., on analytics or relevance tuning), and independent or hands-on corroboration of Agent Studio output quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Agent Studio connects your chosen LLM to Algolia search and tools. It manages the end-to-end workflow and grounds responses in live data from your Algolia indices.
**Shopping assistants** that answer product questions and recommend items.
Recommend - ML-based product recommendations (frequently bought together, related items, trending)
